title: Lazar's leak as a planned counterintelligence release

tellings.quote: So they give it to somebody whose reputation is is really not that good.

related.note: Both explain how Lazar's S-4 story got out as an intelligence move around 1988-89. The story says Lazar was pushed out after Lear gave files to Knapp; this telling says the leak was a planned release through someone with a poor reputation. These are competing core claims about the same event.

plain: The researcher Grant Cameron suggests to Michels that the story of Bob Lazar, a man who claims he worked on alien spacecraft at a secret site in Nevada around 1988 and 1989, may have been a planned release by intelligence officers rather than a true leak. In Cameron's reading, which he offers without naming a source, "they give it to somebody whose reputation is really not that good", so the information gets out but is easy to dismiss. He ties the idea to John Lear, a figure in the Las Vegas UFO scene, and to the journalist George Knapp, who first aired Lazar.
